title: Make the Python suite a fast gate: mark the long studies slow
description: The full suite passes (1,812 passed, 1 skipped) but takes 12 minutes locally and 10 in the last recorded Actions run, which is the cost of every make check under the local-CI rule. Do: time the suite (pytest --durations=30), mark the long replay, study and editorial-corpus fixtures with @pytest.mark.slow, register the marker in pyproject.toml, have make test run -m 'not slow' and add make test-all for the whole suite that release_to_main.sh runs before promoting. Done when: make test is under five minutes, make test-all is the full suite, both documented in docs/dev-procedures.md. Review doc: https://claude.ai/code/artifact/dcd5a089-28f1-4a3f-9f2f-a293789709c0 (Cyclotron review, 2026-10-17).
